row:
Hi fam, My Name is Mukani Nobela-Tingini(AKA.DRNOBS): A Veterinarian, living and practicing in South Africa. I am passionate about taking Veterinary Education to where it is mostly needed and not easily accessible.

I am a wife and a mother of two babies, one human baby and one fur baby. Please join me in this journey as I educate communities about animal health, animal welfare/wellbeing as well as talk all things veterinary medicine.

Legal disclaimer: Please note that everything on this channel is purely the opinion of the author aka me. Nothing on this channel is a reflection or opinion of any organization/company that I may work for.
To veterinarians: The channel is purely meant to educate the community at large. It is by no means meant to undermine or disrespect the profession.
To My Viewers: The channel is purely meant for educational purposes, and it does not replace the need to visit your local Vet when required.

Please subscribe and click the notification bell. Na Nkhensa
